# A03-S09: Composition

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Hi [████]
Don't be upset. That is not the purpose of the email. It is good that we agree – because breadth is important to get many on board. Is the presentation text a dialogue between you and AI? Or purely curated AI? And yes, the language is everyday-like. I just think we need to get started.

By caricatured I meant that Julina reacts/expresses like a human, a politician, but without being one. Demagogue is too strong a word, Julina will attract some voters, hopefully many – based on some of all the data (OpenAI and popular) it is built on and trained with. We are excited about the development!

You are [unreadable character]artist in residency[unreadable character].
